observations: An isolated short-lived QA process used only a Claude parser pool with obsolete release_idle_session_min=0. The serving QA Relay and real provider queues were untouched; the test config used a dummy provider credential, loopback-only provider API URL and unique local listener ports.

The isolated process exited code 1 in under one second. Its private log contained 'release_idle_session_min is no longer supported; use idle_release_timeout (e.g. 1h or 0)' and a startup-failed indication, not the daemon-started message. No test-only listener persisted or QA workspace was created.
The original QA Relay remained ready with both QA pool-health gauges one. Private test config and log were removed after checksum and ownership review; no raw log or credential value is published.

events.summary: Private QA-only config contained obsolete Claude release_idle_session_min=0, disabled the Cursor provider, used a dummy provider credential and loopback-only endpoints.
Launched the QA binary against the private invalid config, not the serving Relay config.
Exit code 1; sanitized check of the private log confirmed obsolete key and idle_release_timeout replacement named in the startup failure.
Original QA Relay healthy with both pool gauges one, no QA workspace visible and no test-only listener bound.
Test config and private log removed from the owned isolated directory after verification.

cleanup: The isolated process exited code 1 at 00:09:31 UTC; its private config/log were removed at 00:10:12 UTC. Test ports 22114/22115 were unbound, no QA workspaces existed and the serving Relay retained its healthy baseline configuration.
